title: Luxuriously Buttery Australian Oats Pancakes
description: Buttery and shattering Australian oats pancakes perfect for a date night, made with porridge oats and a fermentation process, low-fat friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the oats, flour, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter, eggs, and milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Sprinkle the yeast over the top of the batter and let it sit for 5 minutes.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes hot with your choice of toppings.
